sections.Profile:
"Miss Universo" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Inder around 1970. The game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, and a horseshoe lane.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pageantry, Women, Original Theme, 1970s
